note: What a server streaming a match sends to carry one fragment of a chunk or key frame of recorded messages (see spec/spectating.md). The header carries zero.

fields.name: chunk
fields.note: The chunk's id, or the key frame's.

fields.name: fragments
fields.note: How many fragments the chunk is cut into.

fields.name: index
fields.note: This fragment's place, from 0.

fields.name: kind
fields.note: What the chunk is. Any kind but 2 is a chunk rather than a key frame.

3.name: endOfStartup
3.note: The last chunk of the match's setting up.

4.name: gameStart
4.note: The chunk the match proper begins with.

fields.name: size
fields.note: The whole chunk's size in bytes.

fields.name: duration
fields.note: How long the chunk runs, as a whole number; the unit is not recorded.

fields.name: nextChunk
fields.note: For a key frame, the next chunk's id.

fields.name: data
fields.note: This fragment's bytes of the chunk, to the end of the message.

revisions.note: A fragment whose index is 0 begins a chunk, and the chunk's facts come from it; the chunk is complete at the fragment whose index is fragments − 1.
